_README: Corrections for episodes whose description does not follow the
'Part N of "Series"' convention that blob_path() relies on.
KEY   : the episode URL (preferred, stable) or the exact episode title.
Trailing slash and letter case are ignored.
series    - series name, or null to force Standalone
part      - part number, or null for a series with no numbering
scripture - overrides the auto-detected scripture reference
An override replaces whatever the description parser produced, and marks
the episode series_match=override so it is not flagged as a warning.
AFTER EDITING THIS FILE, see the 'rectify' notes at the bottom.
